Weekend plan: rest.
Actual weekend: built SystemOneHarness, an open source harness for System 1 models like #Jev from @typesafeai. Then, to test it, taught it to play Mario.

No chain of thought. No reflection. Just vibes at 60 decisions per second. It's better than me now, which…
